title: Angel hair and an ablative craft hull

tellings.quote: I talked about in my book that the external part of the craft may be ablative sacrificial

plain: Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who worked on UFO questions, talks on Jesse Michels's podcast about angel hair, the fine threads people sometimes report falling from the sky after sightings. He says that, as he wrote in his book Imminent, the outer skin of these craft may be ablative, built to burn or wear away as it is used, which could explain the threads.
